items: Higher Quality and Lower Costs - These 100ft extra-long outdoor string lights are equipped with our upgraded heavy-duty wires and 52 shatterproof Edison bulbs, which can be easily connected up to 15 strands. You can place them in a larger area without worrying about length and frequent replacements. With a lifespan of over 30,000 hours, our energy-saving string lights will not only provide brighter lighting but also cut down on your electricity bills by 90% compared to incandescent ones.

Weatherproof and Safer - Our weatherproof technology ensures that these durable outdoor string lights can withstand rain, wind, snow, and extreme temperatures up to 158 degrees Fahrenheit, allowing you to confidently leave them outside year-round. Furthermore, the bulb shells are made of hard anti-drop plastic, protecting you and your family while hanging the waterproof backyard string lights, eliminating worries about sudden broken glass shards.

Classic Bistro Ambience - These vintage string lights come with ST38 tear-drop E12 bulbs that provide a nice, soft yellow glow without being too bright or too dark. These LED bulbs not only offer an old-fashioned appearance but are also compatible with most dimmers (not included, dimmer purchased separately) for better lighting flexibility. They are a great choice for creating your own outdoor paradise, where you can enjoy your time after a busy day or have a cozy party with your friends.

Super Convenient and Widely Used - Hanging these LED string lights is a breeze with built-in hooks or zip ties. We have even improved the hooks, sockets, and cords to ensure that you can use our string lights without facing sudden breakage. These easy-to-use outdoor party string lights are fabulous decorations for your garden, bistro, balcony, terrace, pergola, gazebo, tent, pool umbrella, cafe, bedroom, living room, market, wedding, birthday, Christmas party, or other occasions.

Brightever's Guarantee - We proudly stand behind all of our products 100% and value every feedback from you. Ensuring the satisfaction of our customers with each purchase has always been and will always remain our top priority.
